text:
Priyanka (Eng - Toronto): hey folks 1 heads up: i'm relocating from Toronto to Mexico City in late Sep. questions: will my monthly WFH stipend continue across MX payroll, do we need a Mexican employer registration, and any visa/work-permit help from Redwood?
Diego (People Ops): congrats! :tada: high-level: payroll usually moves to local entity once you're tax resident. stipend continuation depends on MX policy eligibility. we can assist with work-permit referrals but Redwood doesn't sponsor visas directly in all markets. what's your target arrival?
Priyanka (Eng - Toronto): aiming for 2026-09-22. final day on CA payroll 2026-09-15.
Avery (Payroll Americas): noted. we prefer month-start cutovers but can support mid-month. payroll needs your RFC (tax id) once you register in MX; until then we'll use provisional tax withholding.
Priyanka (Eng - Toronto): i've been receiving CAD$180/month stipend. i bought a monitor earlier and submitted the expense last week. will that be affected?
Diego (People Ops): if expense processed in Canadian payroll before cutover we leave it. recurring stipend: if Mexico is covered under our global allowance policy we continue it via MX payroll; otherwise might pause. we'll check policy coverage.
Luis (Finance LATAM): flag on employer registration: Mexico requires employer registration and social contributions for residents. even one employee generally triggers registration obligations for payroll. that's separate from corporate tax nexus for sales, but it's an employer obligation we can't avoid if someone becomes resident.
Legal LATAM: also note: having an employee in MX can create local permanent establishment risk if the employee can sign contracts or habitually concludes deals there. purely internal product work usually keeps risk low. keep contract-signing centralized.
Priyanka (Eng - Toronto): i won't be client-facing or signing contracts. just product work and occasional internal meetings.
Tax LATAM: practical: MX has mandatory social security (IMSS) and payroll withholding. timing matters for benefits and local filings. we recommend getting local tax advice; Tax can loop in external counsel.
Priyanka (Eng - Toronto): does Redwood reimburse relocation shipping? and any help for local bank account setup?
Diego (People Ops): relocation policy covers shipping up to threshold; over that we coordinate a vendor. we can share local bank onboarding guidance and a list of recommended banks. you'll need a local account for MX payroll once onboarded.
Avery (Payroll Americas): operational checklist: 1) submit relocation form (internal) 2) People Ops opens payroll transfer ticket 3) Payroll issues final CA payslip and MX onboarding docs 4) send benefits enrollment link 5) verify RFC/bank/ID 6) first MX pay on the next MX payroll cycle after cutover.
Priyanka (Eng - Toronto): thanks. what about stock/RSU vest timing? i have an RSU vest scheduled 2026-10-05.
Luis (Finance LATAM): important: RSU taxation depends on residency at vest date; moving before/after can change withholding. please flag vest dates in the relocation case so we can advise on tax withholding.
Priyanka (Eng - Toronto): noted, i'll add that. any immediate docs I should upload?
Diego (People Ops): please attach passport, proof of Mexican address or intent to lease, and preferred cutover date on the relocation form: https://hr.redwood.example/relocate. we'll create a case.
Priyanka (Eng - Toronto): submitted now. PeopleOpsBot: "Case #R-6512 created and assigned to Diego. Reminder: LATAM payroll cutover SLA 12 business days."
Tax LATAM: quick note: Mexico has specific reporting for foreign-sourced income and could expect annual filings. also watch for the 30% rule on certain benefit valuations. we'll send a checklist.
Legal LATAM: also ensure your employment contract has the right local terms once you convert to MX payroll; we'll send a local addendum for signature.
Avery (Payroll Americas): please add your RFC when you get it; otherwise expect provisional withholding. bank details as soon as possible to avoid delays.
Priyanka (Eng - Toronto): thanks everyone 1 appreciate the quick turn. i'll upload RFC and bank once set up.
Diego (People Ops): i'll post a short checklist and ping 3 business days before cutover. PeopleOpsBot: "Reminder: benefits enrollment window opens 2026-09-23 and closes 2026-10-23 for this case."
Priyanka (Eng - Toronto): one last q 1 will my Canadian health coverage stop automatically or do i need to cancel?
Diego (People Ops): provincial coverage depends on your province; often you must formally deregister and allow a waiting period in MX. we'll include a doc about typical provincial timelines and recommend confirming with your provincial health office.
Priyanka (Eng - Toronto): great, thanks team :heart:
